notes.title: Horror Simulator VR Full Version Release Date
notes.content:
The ultimate nightmare begins! Horror Simulator VR has officially launched on Steam, plunging you into a world of relentless terror, strategic survival, and heart-pounding encounters. Will you outsmart the demons… or become their next victim?

[h2]What’s New?[/h2]
🛠️ LOBBY OVERHAUL

Revamped Lobby: Now with a Soul Shop and a Basement crawling with secrets!

🛍️ Soul Shop: Trade Soul Coins for avatars, cosmetics, and decorations. Try before you buy in the new Dressing Room!

🔮 Basement Secrets: Unearth game-breaking items like Decoy Grenades, Night Vision Goggles, and the terrifying Mimic Pill!

😈 DEMON SYSTEM EXPANSION

10 New Demons: Face Astaroth, Sitri, Halphas, and more. Each brings unique horrors:

🗡️ Shax: Silence your teammates during hunts.

🧠 Allocer: Sanity drains slower… until you get too close.

🗺️ STRATEGY UPGRADES

Demon Tracking Rules: From "Easy" (track from start) to Insanity Mode (NO tracking!).

🎒 Backpack System: Carry 4 items now—grab tools directly from your back!

[h2]Survival Essentials[/h2]
🔥 Wishlist & Play Now: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3063780/Horror_Simulator_VR_COOP]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3063780/Horror_Simulator_VR_COOP[/url]

Why Play?

3 Maps: Explore abandoned mansions, cursed forests, and derelict hospitals.

Dozens of Power-Ups: Outwit demons with Speedy Lollipops, Voice Changers, and more.

Unscripted Terror: Every playthrough is a fresh nightmare.

Ready to test your sanity?

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 2025.2.14
notes.content:
[h1]🎮 Horror Simulator Version Update Notes 🎮[/h1]
[h3] What's New:[/h3]
🎭 Avatar masks are now purchasable with Soul Coins! Gold coins can only be used to buy items.
🗓️ Added Weekly and Daily Quests! Complete weekly quests to earn Soul Coins and daily quests for gold coins.
� New In-Game Challenges that refresh randomly each round – earn extra gold coins!
👜 Introduced the Armbank, a new way to store items on your arm, replacing the old bubble system.
✋ Long-distance grabbing now has two modes: Finger and Palm. Choose your preference in the settings!
🔄 Added an option to disable the joystick during rotation.
[h3] Bug Fixes:[/h3]
� Fixed a bug where hunting speed could randomly slow down.
🦾 Fixed an issue where arms could sometimes stretch unnaturally.
🕳️ Fixed a bug causing players to occasionally fall through the ground.
🎮 Fixed a bug where players could get stuck in the game flow upon entering.
🔔 Fixed an issue where the Summoning Bell wouldn’t disappear after use.
🛗 Fixed a mismatch between the number of elevator ready-state lights and actual players.
🦖 Fixed a bug where switching to the Dinosaur Avatar wouldn’t save properly.
🛠️ Fixed an issue where elevator lights didn’t turn on correctly in the tutorial.
💡 Resolved flickering issues with certain objects when illuminated by headlamps in dark environments.
[h3] Optimizations:[/h3]
🎲 Adjusted the trigger probability for The Grasp.
👵 Optimized the wandering paths of the Grandma’s minions in Insanity Mode.
😈 Demon Behavior Improvements:
- Aini: Players lose sanity faster when Aini is nearby.
- Foras: Occasionally tracks locked players and prioritizes them during hunts.
- Buer: More likely to hunt when hearing players, but calmer when not.
- Ose: Stays visible longer during hunts.
- Paimon: Increased throwing force for objects.

Get ready for a spookier and smoother experience! 👻🎉
JOIN OUR DISCORD FOR EVENT AND GIVEAWAYS! [url=https://discord.gg/hsvr]https://discord.gg/hsvr[/url]

notes.title: Horror Simulator's FAQ
notes.content:
🎮 In-game info
Q: What is the general type and introduction of the game?
A: This is a multiplayer horror adventure game that supports up to 3 players in co-op mode. The game is based on the Seven Deadly Sins, where different demons appear in each session. Players must use various tools to uncover the sins of the demons and complete tasks to earn rewards. The game supports up to 3 players online, and it’s a lot of fun and thrilling to play with friends. Multiplayer increases interaction and lets players explore and reveal the demons' sins together.

Q: How difficult is the game, and is it suitable for beginners?
A: The game has five difficulty levels, and we recommend beginners start with the lowest difficulty to get familiar with the game mechanics. The game may be a bit complex for newcomers, but you can still enjoy the atmosphere. As you get more familiar with the game, you can gradually try higher difficulties.

Q: What role do sanity and light play in the game?
A: Light is very important. Keeping the light on prevents sanity from dropping too quickly. If you stay in the dark for too long, your sanity will decrease, and the demons will become more active, even hunting players. You can keep the light on by using lamps, but be aware that the light sources are limited, and if you use too many, the circuit will trip. You’ll need to find the circuit breaker to restore the power.

Q: What is the death mechanism like?
A: Death is inevitable in the game. When a demon gets close and you hear the background music (BGM), it may signify your death. Once you die, you become a ghost and can no longer communicate with your living teammates, but you can still help by picking up items. As a ghost, you can see the demon’s true form but can’t interfere directly.


Q: How to effectively use the items?
A: Each item corresponds to a different sin and can help players uncover the demon's sin and locate its position:
The Watch: Reveals Sloth. Helps the exorcist quickly locate the demon’s activity area by sensing the demon’s presence through the watch's changing hands.
Crucifix: Reveals Pride. When touching sudden abnormal phenomena (e.g., lights suddenly turning on or items being thrown around), it triggers an effect to reduce the demon's activity range.
The Heart of Michael: Reveals Greed. The closer the Heart of Michael is to the demon, the faster its heartbeat. The demon will lower the temperature around it, and the Greedy demon will freeze the Heart of Michael.
Holy Water: Reveals Wrath. Burns the Wrathful demon, damaging it when directly confronting the player.
The Seductive Conch: Reveals Lust. In the dark, it will play an eerie tune, the demon’s low murmur.
The Grasp: Reveals Envy. This beautiful relic blooms in the light, drawing the Envious demon's attention and exposing its location.
The Staff of Revelation: Reveals Gluttony. This sacred object from the demon's hand allows the player to see the demon’s image, helping to formulate better strategies by observing its movements.


Q: What are the items bought from the store used for?
A:
Cleansing Potion: Restores a certain amount of sanity, giving players more safe time during exploration.
Bible: When held, it can protect the player from a deadly attack, preventing the demon from killing them and ending the chase.
White Sage: When burned, it creates smoke that temporarily blinds the demon, providing a chance for the player to escape or retaliate. It’s recommended to carry it.
Soulbringer: Shaking it three times summons the souls of the dead to revive fallen teammates, providing additional support and survival chances for the team.
Ghost Talkie: When turned on, you can communicate with ghosts and gather information through their perspective, helping you better understand the current situation.
Pepper — 12/12/2024 8:43 PM


Q: What is Crazy Mode?
A: Crazy Mode is an enhanced hunting mechanism based on different ghost models in the original hunting logic. The types of demons you may encounter include:
The Nun: The Nun has the ability to clone itself, and the clones will teleport to random rooms to surround and hunt the players.
Lisa: A witch who randomly seals room doors. When a player is trapped in a room, Lisa will quickly come to hunt that player.
Evil Grandma: The lights in the scene will change color, and she will summon hellish minions to help restrict player movement, relentlessly pursuing the players.
Bald Head: A creature from hell that prefers to hunt silently. When stared at by a player, it will slow down, but when the player has their back turned, it will hunt at lightning speed!
🚀 Regarding the Game’s Release:
Q: What is the difference between the EA and Demo versions?
A: In the Demo, players can unlock multiplayer mode via the community and experience only the first map. After purchasing the EA version, players will be able to experience the second map and all future content we develop. There will be no additional cost after the full release. The second map includes more new items (which require in-game currency to purchase) and the exciting Madness Mode, offering players more content to enjoy.

Q: Will my progress in the Demo carry over to the EA version?
A: Yes, any masks and coins obtained in the Demo will carry over to the EA version once you make the purchase. If you encounter any issues, please submit a support ticket with your player ID for assistance.
